bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1803 Released - This Canary Channel update includes refinements to **Pen settings** and improved voice typing.
New Canary Build 29560.1000 Available - This update addresses freezes and USB device issues for **Windows Insiders**.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26300.8155 Released - This **Dev Channel** build introduces haptic feedback for compatible devices.
Beta Channel Build 26220.8148 Now Live - This release enhances **Windows Protected Print Mode** and touchpad settings.
Microsoft Named Leader in Gartner Magic Quadrant - Recognized for excellence in **Integration Platform as a Service** for the eighth consecutive year.
AI Threat Landscape Evolving - Threat actors are embedding **AI** into cyberattacks, increasing precision and effectiveness.
New Features in Copilot Studio - Multi-agent orchestration capabilities are now available, enhancing collaboration across tools.
Babylon.js 9.0 Enhancements Announced - New features include **OpenPBR** support and improved dynamic IBL shadows for 3D rendering.
Mitigating Axios npm Supply Chain Compromise - Malicious versions of **Axios** npm packages have been identified, linked to North Korean actors.
Navigating Digital Sovereignty - Microsoft emphasizes the importance of operational continuity and AI governance in digital transformation.
